title: 1 Nuke vs. 1 Queen
summary: Tony's queen is replaced by a Nuke (queen + knightrider: knight leaps repeated any distance in one direction, blockable) vs Fairy-Stockfish. The nuke can jump to f5 on move 1. He plays normal theory, uses the nuke's reach in the middlegame and wins with a ladder mate (~20:36). Board switched to neutral blue after viewers' feedback on purple.
rules: Player's queen replaced by a Nuke: queen moves + knightrider moves (repeated (2,1) leaps in a straight line; each intermediate landing square must be empty).

board.theme_notes: neutral blue-grey/white board (Tony: 'keep it to the more neutral blue'); green arrows
